spiritgiven.comments: For the 3 they had wonderful body control on bids, very appreciative of their mindfulness of our players in respect to that.
Everything was fine, a lot of miscommunication that was resolved. Nothing out of the ordinary on their end

I lot of pregame talk about what we wanted from the match, hound king approached is on many occasions to have talks, one talking about taunting. I believe it was a misunderstanding as we belive it was a cultural difference as we celebrate all the small wins we get.

Communication during the game could have been better but then again there wasn’t much reason which is why I opted for a 2 and not a one, that was the only issue outside of that it was a wonderful game.

There was alot of tough stops throughout this game, there was alot of poor communication to talk out calls even with translators. It seemed like they would yell at eachother to where one of our players saw one of theirs cry after being yelled at(allegedly not sure due to language barrier). We had issues with body contact and were unfamiliar with many rules, no major ones just the small things that began to add up.
For the 1 they seemed to be visibly angry and doing things such as kicking the floor, cursing and throwing hats.

A really good game, no issues apart from 2 that were noted at half time that we acted on immediately to fix, great talks to resolve calls even with the need of translators at times. Great job Austria!

There weren’t any huge issues just small ones that were repetitive, their coaches seemed to be yelling from the sidelines mad everytime a call was made yelling stuff like “that was so clean, play on”. Had a lot of disputes over rules, such as the offside rule and contact rule on marks.

Had very few issues it was a great game, we had small issues, none with the team as a whole but rather with individual plays in the match. There was a dangerous play that was unnecessary, and there was an incident where the disc was down and clear and they refused to admit it was despite their teammate telling them it was. Nothing big just stuff to work toward not doing.
It was an amazing last game, thank you Poland!

spiritreceived.comments: Just an observation, make the calls instantly, don't wait for the play to be over. Great game, great spirit.

1. General Rules (ie throwing the disc away when a call is made could result in a turnover).
3. A little bit of contesting calls that are fair and true but overall ok
4. Great positive attitude on the field as well as on the sideline. Be aware of things said on the sideline no matter the language. Overall, loved the spirit keep it up!!
You had a very good Team Spirit:)
Thank you for this very spirited and intense game!
There were too much doubleteams (which whe calls multiple times) and contact from female matching players.
